metadata.name: floor_launch
metadata.description: FLOOR on Solana: factory, sale, Pausable custody lock, registry and recipient claims

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: signer is not the required authority

errors.name: BadConfig
errors.msg: launch configuration is invalid

errors.name: MintBelowQuote
errors.msg: mint must sort above its quote mint

errors.name: BadRecipientConfig
errors.msg: fee recipient / pending recipient configuration is invalid

errors.name: RegistryIndexRace
errors.msg: registry_count changed; re-read and re-sign

errors.name: Nothing
errors.msg: the purchase buys nothing

errors.name: Slippage
errors.msg: fewer tokens than min_tokens

errors.name: GraduationCostExceeded
errors.msg: graduation would cost the final buyer more than max_graduation_lamports

errors.name: SaleOver
errors.msg: the sale is over

errors.name: InsufficientAllocation
errors.msg: sell-back exceeds the allocation

errors.name: DelegateMissing
errors.msg: CPI Guard account has no sufficient delegation to the Launch

errors.name: EscrowShort
errors.msg: sale vault holds less than it must

errors.name: CannotGraduate
errors.msg: the sale cannot graduate in this state

errors.name: NotPending
errors.msg: the launch has no pending recipient

errors.name: Expired
errors.msg: the attestation has expired

errors.name: BadAttestation
errors.msg: the Ed25519 attestation is malformed or not from the attestor

errors.name: PositionNotClosable
errors.msg: buyer position still holds an allocation during the sale

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: LockStateInvalid
errors.msg: the mint's Pausable lock is not in the state the launch requires

errors.name: MintProfileInvalid
errors.msg: the Token-2022 mint profile is not the required profile

errors.name: AccountInUse
errors.msg: an account the program creates already holds data or belongs to another program

errors.name: NotAssociatedTokenAccount
errors.msg: a token account is not the associated token account it must be

errors.name: MetadataBaseInvalid
errors.msg: the metadata base is not an absolute ASCII URL within the length bound

errors.name: MetadataBaseUnset
errors.msg: the launch config has no metadata base set

errors.name: MetadataUriFinal
errors.msg: this mint's metadata uri is already final

errors.name: MetadataBaseTooFresh
errors.msg: the metadata base is too fresh to fill from: governance's correction window is open

errors.name: MinBidOutOfRange
errors.msg: min_bid_lamports is outside the hard range 0.001 .. 5 SOL

errors.name: BountyOutOfRange
errors.msg: the ratchet bounty rate or ceiling is outside its hard range

errors.name: RentReserveShort
errors.msg: the graduation rent reserve holds less than graduation needs

errors.name: NotLaunchCreator
errors.msg: the graduation rent reserve may only be closed by the launch creator

errors.name: PoolMoved
errors.msg: the prepared pool is no longer at the launch's open tick

errors.name: PoolNotPrepared
errors.msg: the pool this launch graduates into does not exist yet

errors.name: QuoteNotListed
errors.msg: the quote mint is not on the FLOOR roster: pass its QuotePolicy (list_quote it first)

errors.name: QuoteRetired
errors.msg: the quote mint is retired: no new launch may be created on it

errors.name: AttestorIsGovernance
errors.msg: the attestor may not be the current governance: one key, one role

errors.name: GovernanceIsAttestor
errors.msg: governance may not be the current attestor: one key, one role

errors.name: AttestorIsTreasuryGovernance
errors.msg: the attestor may not be the platform treasury's governance: one key, one role

errors.name: ReferrerNotAllowed
errors.msg: a referrer is allowed only when the fee recipient is the signing creator, with no pending handle, and not the creator itself

errors.name: ReferrerOffCurve
errors.msg: the referrer must be a wallet (an on-curve key), not a program address

errors.name: HookNotArmed
errors.msg: graduation did not arm the holders hook and renounce its authority (step 8b)

errors.name: HolderRecordMismatch
errors.msg: sell_back on a hooked launch needs [floor_holders, holder_book, floor_pool, holder_record] for this seller

errors.name: TeamFeeOutOfRange
errors.msg: a FLOOR Platform fee setting is above its cap (sale 100 bps, pool 50 bps)

errors.name: TeamTreasuryNotOpen
errors.msg: the team treasury is not open: there is no team governance to set the FLOOR Platform fee

errors.name: AttestorIsTeamTreasuryGovernance
errors.msg: the attestor may not be the team treasury's governance: one key, one role

errors.name: GenesisNotScheduled
errors.msg: the genesis raise has no schedule

errors.name: GenesisScheduleFrozen
errors.msg: the genesis raise has opened: its schedule and floor share are frozen

errors.name: GenesisInvalidSchedule
errors.msg: the genesis schedule is invalid

errors.name: GenesisSaleNotActive
errors.msg: the genesis raise is not open

errors.name: GenesisSaleNotEnded
errors.msg: the genesis raise has not ended

errors.name: GenesisNotGraduated
errors.msg: the genesis launch has not graduated

errors.name: GenesisZeroContribution
errors.msg: a contribution must be more than zero

errors.name: GenesisBadConfig
errors.msg: the genesis configuration is invalid

errors.name: GenesisAllocationsOutstanding
errors.msg: a contributor has not claimed yet: the allocation dust is not final

errors.name: GenesisStepOutOfOrder
errors.msg: that genesis step is out of order

errors.name: NotGenesisAuthority
errors.msg: only the genesis authority may do that

errors.name: GenesisRentLocked
errors.msg: the genesis reserve is locked until the sale has graduated and made its locks

errors.name: SkimSellMultipleOutOfRange
errors.msg: the at-floor sell multiple must be 0 (1.5x) or 10,000..=50,000 bps (1x..=5x)

errors.name: SkimSellAtFloorAboveCap
errors.msg: the at-floor sell skim (far sell x multiple) must be no higher than 1,500 bps (15 %)

errors.name: StairDropped
errors.msg: the hook did not record the staircase (upgrade floor_hook first)

errors.name: StairDoesNotFit
errors.msg: the staircase does not fit between the open price and the top of the tick range

errors.name: GenesisStairTopUnset
errors.msg: the $FLOOR staircase's top market cap (quote units) must be set, and non-zero, before the raise opens

errors.name: TeamBuyOutOfRange
errors.msg: the team buy must be at most 5% of supply with at least 80% on team steps, a lock of 90..=1825 days

errors.name: TeamBuyNeedsStaircase
errors.msg: a team buy needs a staircase preset (team steps live on the staircase)

errors.name: StairOwnerDropped
errors.msg: the hook did not record the team steps (upgrade floor_hook first)

errors.name: TeamNothingVested
errors.msg: nothing of the deployer's wallet part has vested since the last claim

errors.name: PayeeNotPending
errors.msg: the steps' payee is not a pending handle

errors.name: TeamStepsOverCap
errors.msg: the team steps would be more than 25 % of the staircase

errors.name: StairRentFunded
errors.msg: this launch's staircase rent budget is already moved, or it has none

errors.name: WrongStairRent
errors.msg: the stair_rent account is not this launch's pool reserve

errors.name: GraduationRentLocked
errors.msg: the graduation rent reserve is locked until the launch graduates (9A)

errors.name: AttestorIsPauseGuardian
errors.msg: the attestor may not be the AMM's pause guardian

errors.name: GenesisWhitelistUnset
errors.msg: the genesis whitelist root is not set (set_genesis_whitelist, non-zero, before the open)

errors.name: GenesisNotWhitelisted
errors.msg: this wallet is not on the genesis whitelist (or the proof is wrong)

errors.name: GenesisWalletCapExceeded
errors.msg: a wallet may contribute at most 20 SOL in the Core phase and 5 SOL in phase 2

errors.name: GenesisDurationNotFixed
errors.msg: the genesis schedule carries Core's 300 seconds; phase 2 runs until the authority closes it

errors.name: GenesisGraduationDeployerOnly
errors.msg: only the genesis authority may close the raise and graduate it

errors.name: GenesisNothingVested
errors.msg: nothing of the raise allocation has vested yet (14-day cliff from the sale end)

errors.name: GenesisWrongPhase
errors.msg: the genesis raise is not in that phase (Core: the first 300 s; F&F: from then until the authority closes it)

errors.name: GenesisPhaseSoldOut
errors.msg: this genesis phase is sold out (Core 20M tokens / 80 SOL; phase 2 22.5M / 90 SOL)

errors.name: GenesisRefundNotOpen
errors.msg: the genesis refund opens 14 days after the authority closes the raise, and only if it has not graduated

errors.name: GenesisNothingToRefund
errors.msg: this wallet has nothing to refund (never contributed, or already refunded)

errors.name: GenesisRefundWindowOpen
errors.msg: the genesis refund window is open: the raise can no longer graduate (or this wallet was refunded)

errors.name: QuoteChainBadHop
errors.msg: the quote chain's hop is not a graduated preset (or $FLOOR) pool of the current quote

errors.name: ParentTwapTooYoung
errors.msg: a parent pool's TWAP does not yet reach 30 minutes: the child cannot be priced off it

errors.name: QuoteChainCut
errors.msg: the quote chain was cut short: its root is a graduated FLOOR launch token

errors.name: QuoteWalkStale
errors.msg: the quote walk is stale (over 60 s since its first step): restart it

errors.name: QuoteWalkIncomplete
errors.msg: the quote walk has not reached its root (or is already finished)

errors.name: QuoteWalkMismatch
errors.msg: the quote walk does not belong to this payer and quote

errors.name: PresetUnknown
errors.msg: no preset is registered under this id

errors.name: PresetDisabled
errors.msg: this preset is disabled for new launches

errors.name: PresetTableFull
errors.msg: the preset registry is full (ids up to 31)

errors.name: PresetInvalid
errors.msg: the preset row breaks the rule table (the field is logged)

errors.name: BadTraderLinkShape
errors.msg: the trader link's tiers are not well formed (tier 1 set, no gaps, no self, no repeats)

errors.name: AlreadyLinked
errors.msg: this trader is already linked

errors.name: TraderTierOffCurve
errors.msg: a trader referral tier is not a wallet (off the ed25519 curve)

errors.name: TraderRefMismatch
errors.msg: the trader-referral accounts do not belong to this trade (bucket, sale account or hook accounts)

errors.name: SaleReferralAlreadyOpen
errors.msg: the launch's sale referral account is already open

errors.name: BadRecipients
errors.msg: bad creator recipients (the check code is in the log)

errors.name: GenesisPayeeUseGenesisClaim
errors.msg: $FLOOR's genesis payee is claimed through claim_genesis_payee

errors.name: BadWsolDestination
errors.msg: the wSOL payout account is not the seller's native SPL Token wSOL account

errors.name: WsolPayoutNotNative
errors.msg: a wSOL payout exists only on a launch quoted in wSOL
